# Cube Design System (Web)

> Internal docs for Cube Web components. Foundation components are HeroUI v3 with the Cube theme. Cube components are `@bosagent/cube-ui`. Mobile is out of scope.

## Guide

- [Overview](https://yuchuanux-a11y.github.io/cube-preview/docs/llms/index.md): how to import components and read these docs
- [Changelog](https://yuchuanux-a11y.github.io/cube-preview/docs/llms/changelog.md): git history generated at build time
